server.name: openmail
server.title: OpenMail
server.description: OpenMail is an email inbox for AI agents. Read autoReplyable mail (people and other agents; not spam, bulk, or bounces) and reply in-thread. Do not invent From addresses. Hosted URL: https://mcp.openmail.sh/mcp (sign in required; docs only at /mcp/public)

protocolMetadata.instructions:
OpenMail gives the agent its own email inboxes.
Start with auth_me to see which credential and inbox you have. No inbox yet: setup_agent_email (plan first, then execute=true).
Mailbox loop: list_unread_threads → read_thread → reply_to_thread → mark_thread_read. It lists machine mail too; only reply to threads marked autoReplyable: yes.
For the latest or most recent email, call list_unread_threads with include_read: true. It lists machine mail too, flagged autoReplyable: no.
Use reply_to_thread for replies and send_email only for new conversations. Pass inbox_id when the account has more than one inbox (list_inboxes).
Never invent From addresses or paste API keys into chat. Custom domains: add_domain → user publishes DNS → verify_domain.
Unsure how something works: search_docs, then get_docs.

_published_faq.name: How do I add OpenMail to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add OpenMail to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.openmail.sh/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is OpenMail MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 16, 2026, OpenMail scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is OpenMail's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 16, 2026, OpenMail scores 87/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 21 of 21 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to OpenMail?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to OpenMail in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, Granola, Fleet Connected Apps, and inkbox.
